profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at The Hartford
profile.summary: Who knew starting a music webzine in the late 90s would lead to an exceptional career with a proven track record of successful web development positions within the insurance, marketing, event services, and healthcare supply industries.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with team engineers to implement 3rd Party API service integrations
- Established & directed code solutions for WCAG accessibility within Duck Creek SaaS platform leading to a 77% reduction in violations
- Spearheaded native Mobile Control Presentation implementation of dropdowns & keypads from concept thru development & unit testing
- Mentored other developers on xhtml, JavaScript and SaSS nuances & customizations of Duck Creek's Author software
- Created & delivered presentations across other internal lines of business across the organization to educate & train engineers on mobile first and WCAG accessibility development
- Co-directed Policy integration of Duck Creek 7.2 Platform upgrade
- Earned AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Practitioner & Duck Creek Author Developer Certifications
- Developed pages in Duck Creek Author platform (MVVM) from provided layouts
- Directed Duck Creek solution engineers on platform & UI/UX enhancements

projects.title: In Depth E-Zine
projects.description: Long before the days of Facebook and MySpace and any sort of streaming music service the only way to find out about new bands or established ones was through print magazines or via "the internet" which was still in it's infancy. In 1997 I created a couple of small websites for a couple of new bands I had seen in New York City club using nothing more than HTML and CSS. After a lot of positive feedback I started contacting record labels inquiring if I could interview some of their artists for promotion on my new site, In Depth. The responses were slow but steady as even they were unsure of this "internet thing" at that point. From 1997 to 2005 I would promote different hard rock / metal bands on In Depth by coordinating, crafting, conducting and transcribing interviews with musicians, writing album and concert reviews and taking and posting live concert photos.
